title: Etaleness descends to a finite stage of a limit
statement: Let $I$ be a directed set and $(S_i,f_{ii'})$ an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $I$ with affine transition morphisms [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit $S=\varprojlim_iS_i$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition]. Let $0\in I$ and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a morphism of schemes over $S_0$, where $S_0$, $X_0$, $Y_0$ are quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For $i\ge0$ let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be the base change of $f_0$ to $S_i$ ($X_i=X_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, $Y_i=Y_0\times_{S_0}S_i$, fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) and $f:X\to Y$ its base change to $S$. If $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] and $f_0$ is locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], then $f_i$ is etale for some $i\ge0$ (Stacks Limits, Lemma 07RP).
